description: Retrieves advisory EDGA course planning guidance with verified national participation baselines (UDisc partnership), source links, evidence dates and verification limits. include_case_studies.description: Include source-reported Forestry England, Telford Town Park, or Bristol DGC figures with verification status and evidence periods.

include_sign_off_stories.description: Include suggested approval discussion points with their evidence limits.

landowner_type.description: The target landowner or managing authority.
